# shacdn

> shacdn is a React 19 + TypeScript implementation of shadcn/ui built on SCSS modules: no Tailwind, no Radix, no external UI libraries. Components are copied into your project (you own the source), share one token file (`src/styles/variables.scss`), and support light/dark themes with six color schemes.

This is the short index. More: [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) (every component with exports, dependencies and usage), [catalog.json](/catalog.json) (machine-readable metadata).

## Install

From the shacdn repo, copy the design system and any components (internal dependencies are resolved for you):

```bash
npm run shacdn:install -- /path/to/your-app
npm run shacdn:install -- /path/to/your-app --components Button,Card,Input
```

Required npm packages: react, react-dom, sass. Optional: lucide-react.
Import `src/styles/theme-init` and `src/styles/globals.scss` once in the app entry, then import each component from its folder (`./components/Button/Button`).

## MCP server

Local stdio server (`mcp/shacdn-server`). Tools: list_components, search_components, get_component, get_component_bundle, get_install_command, get_design_system, get_integration_guide, install_to_project, list_screen_patterns, get_screen_pattern.

## Components (126)

- Accordion: Expandable FAQ / disclosure sections.
- ActivityHeatmap: Year-at-a-glance contribution grid, one square per day.
- Alert: Inline status banner on page.
- AlertDialog: Blocking confirmation for destructive actions.
- AnimatedList: Staggered fade-and-rise entrance for a vertical list.
- AnimatedText: Text motion: fade, blur, slide, typewriter, gradient, scramble, word rotate, highlight.
- AspectRatio: Fixed aspect ratio container for media.
- Attachment: File/image attachment preview with upload states and actions.
- Avatar: User avatar with fallback initials, badge and overlapping group.
- Badge: Status tag or label chip.
- Banner: Full-width page-level notice, optionally dismissible.
- Bento: Mixed-span CSS grid layout (bento box).
- Breadcrumb: Page hierarchy navigation.
- Bubble: Chat message bubble with variants and reactions slot.
- Button: Action button or link CTA (supports href).
- ButtonGroup: Grouped buttons with shared border.
- Calendar: Month grid date picker with single and range selection.
- Callout: In-content notice with accent border (info/warning/success/danger).
- Card: Content card with header/footer.
- Carousel: Horizontal scroll-snap carousel (no Embla).
- Chart: Zero-dep SVG charts: bar, grouped bar, diverging bar, donut, sparkline.
- Checkbox: Boolean checkbox input.
- CheckboxCards: Selectable cards for multiple choices (plans, add-ons, peripherals).
- CheckboxGroup: Labeled checkbox list with shared value array.
- Chip: Interactive removable or selectable label.
- CodeBlock: Code sample with copy, highlighted lines, and file tabs.
- Collapsible: Show/hide content region.
- ColorPicker: Swatch trigger with color and hex inputs.
- Combobox: Searchable select: compound Input/Content/List/Item (Appica-style) + legacy options API.
- ComboButton: Primary action joined to a related-actions menu.
- Command: Command palette with search filter.
- ContextMenu: Right-click context menu.
- CopyButton: Copies a value to the clipboard with an in-place confirmation.
- Countdown: Launch countdown with rolling digits that turns into a live state at zero.
- DataList: Key/value definition list for detail and settings rows.
- DatePicker: Date input with calendar popup.
- DateRangePicker: Start/end date input with range calendar popup.
- Dialog: Modal dialog overlay.
- Direction: RTL/LTR direction provider.
- Dock: macOS-style dock with pointer magnification.
- Drawer: Side panel / sheet overlay.
- DropdownMenu: Dropdown action menu with checkbox, radio, shortcut and nested submenu parts.
- Empty: Empty state placeholder.
- ExpandableText: Line-clamped text with a fade and Read more / Show less, shown only on overflow.
- Field: Form field wrapper with label/description.
- FileUpload: Drag-and-drop file picker with type filter and previews.
- FinancialTable: Comparison table for signed amounts, with an accent column for the active scenario.
- Floating: Positioning primitives shared by every popup surface (portal, collision-aware placement, dismiss layer).
- Form: Form composition helpers.
- Gauge: Arc gauge showing a value against a range with threshold tones.
- HoldToConfirm: Destructive action confirmed by press-and-hold (pointer or Space/Enter).
- HoverCard: Rich preview on hover.
- ImageCompare: Before/after image slider with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider.
- InlineEdit: Rename in place: text turns into a field without moving; Enter commits, Escape cancels.
- Input: Single-line text input.
- InputGroup: Input with prefix/suffix addon.
- InputMask: Masked text input for phones, dates, and codes.
- InputOTP: One-time password / PIN input.
- Item: List item row pattern.
- JsonViewer: Collapsible JSON tree with paging for long arrays and copy value / path.
- Kbd: Keyboard shortcut display.
- Label: Form field label.
- Lightbox: Click-to-enlarge media overlay with scrim.
- Marker: Chat status chip or date/unread separator.
- Marquee: Endless horizontal scrolling content strip.
- Masonry: Column-packed variable-height card layout.
- MentionTextarea: Composer textarea with @mentions, /commands autosuggest, and shortened link chips.
- Menubar: Desktop-style menu bar.
- Message: Chat message row: avatar slot + content + header/footer.
- MessageScroller: Scrollable message list with auto-scroll and jump buttons (zero-dep; no @shadcn/react).
- MetricCard: KPI card: value, signed delta with sentiment, optional sparkline.
- Modal: Alias for Dialog API. Alias of Dialog.
- MultiSelect: Multi-value select with chips and checkbox listbox.
- NativeSelect: Styled native <select> element for simple or mobile-first forms.
- NavigationMenu: Site navigation with dropdown panels.
- NumberField: Bounded number input with +/- buttons, arrow/Page/Home/End keys and locale formatting.
- NumberTicker: Animated count toward a number, with prefix, suffix, and decimals.
- OrbitingCircles: Icons traveling on circular orbits around a center.
- Pagination: Page navigation controls.
- PasswordStrength: Live password strength meter with a rules checklist.
- PasswordToggleField: Password input with show/hide toggle.
- Popover: Floating content panel.
- Progress: Linear progress bar.
- ProgressRing: Circular determinate progress indicator.
- Questionnaire: Multi-step question flow with progress and a completion state.
- RadioCards: Selectable cards for a single choice (plan, shipping, billing).
- RadioGroup: Single choice from group.
- Rating: Star rating with keyboard, half steps, and read-only display.
- Resizable: Drag-to-resize panel groups (zero-dep).
- ScheduleCalendar: Week, day and month agenda with typed event contracts, drag move/resize and holiday chips.
- ScrollArea: Custom styled scroll container.
- Scrollspy: On-this-page nav that tracks the visible section.
- SegmentedControl: Single-choice segmented control with a sliding selection indicator.
- Select: Custom listbox select with popup, groups and keyboard navigation.
- Separator: Visual divider line.
- Sheet: Alias for Drawer API. Alias of Drawer.
- ShineBorder: Animated conic-gradient border around any content.
- Sidebar: App sidebar layout with collapse (zero-dep).
- Skeleton: Loading placeholder shimmer.
- Slider: Range slider input.
- Sonner: Registry alias for Toast. Alias of Toast.
- Sortable: Pointer and keyboard reorderable list.
- Spinner: Circular loading indicator.
- SpinningText: Text set on a circle that rotates.
- Stepper: Compact increment/decrement value control.
- Steps: Wizard / checkout step indicator.
- Switch: Toggle switch control.
- Table: Data table with semantic parts.
- TabNav: Link-based navigation that looks like tabs (no panels).
- Tabs: Tabbed panel navigation.
- Textarea: Multi-line text input.
- TextShimmer: Calm light sweep across text to signal ongoing work.
- ThemeSwitcher: Light/dark + color scheme picker.
- ThinkingLoader: Compact AI working pill that walks through phases and settles on a check.
- Timeline: Vertical status timeline for order tracking and event history.
- TimePicker: Segmented time field (12/24h) with typing, arrows and AM/PM.
- Toast: Transient corner notifications.
- Toggle: Pressable toggle button.
- ToggleGroup: Group of toggle buttons.
- TokenField: Text input that commits values as removable tokens.
- Toolbar: Accessible toolbar with roving focus for grouped controls.
- ToolCallCard: Agent tool-call row with timer, arguments, result, copy, and retry.
- Tooltip: Hover/focus tooltip hint.
- TreeView: WAI-ARIA tree for nested folders with roving focus and expand/select.
- Typography: Prose typography primitives (h1–h4, p, lead, muted, blockquote, list).
- UsageMeter: Stacked allowance meter with legend and warning/over-limit tones.
